title: TTF/HH ratio leads Cheniere (LNG)
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] TTF to Henry Hub ratio 20d z-score > 1.25 leads Cheniere returns by 3 days (+) as export arbitrage widens; trade long LNG 5d [finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub -> finance.LNG.log_return]
message: Weak contemporaneous r=0.14 (n=389, lag 0), no lead; long-LNG rule fails OOS (war hit 0.40, excess -0.35%/trade), actionability 1.1: story not a rule

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long LNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] TTF/HH ratio 20d z-score > 1.0 leads LNG returns negatively (-) as the arb spike mean-reverts over 5 days; trade short LNG 5d [finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub -> finance.LNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0036)
